IncBot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall: elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed on inference-gateway starting ~2026-03-15T02:13Z. Alert details: 5xx rate 14% (baseline 0.7%), 95p latency 1.8s. Link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/alerts/221
Emma (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing the page in PagerDuty. Triage in progress, will post findings here.
Emma (oncall): quick check - dashboard shows a sharp jump in prefix-kv error rate and prefix miss rate around 02:12 UTC. Logs show a bunch of 502/503 from kv-prefetch-*. Attaching sample:
```
[2026-03-15T02:12:07Z] kv-prefetch-2 ERROR prefix_lookup failed status=503 err="ttl-desync eviction: stale-meta"
[2026-03-15T02:12:09Z] kv-prefetch-4 WARN high_miss_rate miss_rate=18.4% seq=12562
```
Raj (eng-runtime): I see it too. Cross-checking metrics: prefix-lookup-latency and miss-rate both spike. Origin DB latency looks normal. It seems the distributed TTL metadata got out of sync after a recent rollout of the ttl-propagator job.
Sarah (sre): Are we seeing HB failures between shards or just metadata inconsistencies?
Raj (eng-runtime): Heartbeats are fine. The propagator failed to commit TTL updates for a subset of shards -> those shards started evicting prefixes prematurely leading to read path errors when worker tried to fetch deleted prefix metadata, hitting an error path that returns 503.
Luis (ml-infra): Impact on model-serving: retries increase aggressively; generator requests get multi-second queueing + some clients hit gateway timeouts. I'll prepare fallback routing to smaller model to reduce backend QPS.
Emma (oncall): Plan: 1) throttle incoming requests via rate-limit increase for non-auth customers, 2) flip routing for non-critical routes to fallback model, 3) sequentially recycle affected kv-prefetch pods to rehydrate TTLs from authoritative store, 4) temporarily relax cache read timeout to avoid 5xx bubbling to gateway. Starting step 2 now.
Tom (eng-platform): How do you want me to apply the routing toggle? I can push a canary config.
Emma (oncall): Tom — please apply canary to 10% traffic then 50% if metrics look OK. CLI to use:
```
redwoodctl routing update --route "/v1/generate" --fallback "small-v1" --canary 0.1
```
Tom (eng-platform): canary pushed 10%.
Aisha (support): Heads up: support queue already seeing spike in error reports from customer-acme and beta-team. I'll open status update draft once we have a mitigation note.
Sarah (sre): I'm going to drain kv-prefetch-3 and restart the ttl-propagator there. Doing sequential restarts to avoid mass rehydration storm.
```
kubectl -n infra cordon pod/kv-prefetch-3
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/kv-prefetch-3
```
Raj (eng-runtime): Also bumping the cache-read timeout to 3s (was 1s) to reduce gateway 504s while we stabilize:
```
redwoodctl config set cache.read_timeout=3s --service prefix-cache
```
Emma (oncall): executed the timeout bump. Observability: 5xx rate started dropping from 14% -> 6% within 6 minutes after canary + restart of kv-prefetch-3.
Luis (ml-infra): Pushed fallback routing to 50% after initial positive signal. Generator QPS down ~30% for heavy models.
Aisha (support): Drafted status for affected customers: short outage window, mitigation in progress, routing to fallback, ETA for full recovery ~30-60m. Ready to publish after Ops signoff.
Sarah (sre): Restarting kv-prefetch-4 now (next sequential). Watching miss rate and redis/kv-proxy errors.
Raj (eng-runtime): Observed TTL-sync job error in logs; a recent change to the propagator's checkpointing caused partial commits to be skipped on leadership handover. I'll revert the propagator change and deploy small hotfix.
```
git rev-parse --abbrev=8 HEAD -> a1b2c3d4
git revert a1b2c3d4 --no-edit
helm upgrade ttl-propagator ./charts/ttl-propagator -f values-prod.yaml
```
Tom (eng-platform): Hotfix deployed to canary stage of propagator. Monitoring.
Emma (oncall): Good. Metrics: last 5m 5xx = 2.1%, miss_rate=4.2%. Latency 95p down to 780ms. We're trending healthy but not fully back to baseline.
Luis (ml-infra): Observed reduced retries and queueing on model nodes. No customer-facing errors reported in last 3m from top-10 customers.
Aisha (support): Sent interim status to customer-acme and beta-team with link to status page. They acknowledged, requested postmortem.
Emma (oncall): I'm going to hand this over to Raj for follow-up and postmortem. Actions remaining for follow-up: 1) permanent fix to ttl-propagator checkpointing and leader handover, 2) add alert for prefix-miss-rate >5% for >5m, 3) postmortem write-up + customer impact summary, 4) test to avoid sequential mass rehydration storm.
Raj (eng-runtime): Taking handoff. I'll own the follow-ups and run the postmortem. Thanks Emma. I'll sync with Sarah for the replay steps.
Emma (oncall): handing off to Raj — oncall shift ends in 2h but incident stable. If anything regresses ping this thread and I'll rejoin. :thumbsup:
IncBot: Incident status changed -> mitigated. Severity downgraded to SEV-2. Follow-up assigned to eng-runtime (Raj). Postmortem required.
